about: Scripts by other people. They are not part of this project and not copied here: this file only lists their names and repository links, and the emulator fetches each script from its author's repository when it is loaded. All credit goes to the authors. Authors who would rather not be listed: please open an issue and the entry will be removed.

scripts.name: kria iii
scripts.author: aktsom
scripts.description: 4-track MIDI step sequencer (kria lite). Play/stop: row 7, step 15.

scripts.name: stepiii
scripts.author: nolliegray
scripts.description: A performance step sequencer. Sends MIDI clock; can follow external clock.

scripts.name: arpiii
scripts.author: nolliegray
scripts.description: An arpeggiator and sequencer. Takes notes from a MIDI keyboard; can follow external clock.

scripts.name: fugace
scripts.author: behindkeyframes
scripts.description: A sequencer with 4 playheads on one piano roll. Play/stop: row 7, x5.

scripts.name: fell
scripts.author: liamelliot
scripts.description: Notes play when they fall across a pressed key. Made for grid zero (16×16).

scripts.name: sluiiice
scripts.author: duncangeere
scripts.description: A waterfall. Turn the grid so the USB port faces up.

scripts.name: selector
scripts.author: jonwaterschoot
scripts.description: Script picker: every script on the device gets a slot. Here it lists the bundled scripts.

scripts.name: many-roads
scripts.author: boreal-ground
scripts.description: A script switcher / menu. Here it lists the bundled scripts.
